purpose: Public evidence records for traceable reptile feeding conclusions.

rules.wild_observation_rule: Observed wild ingestion is occurrence evidence, not a captive feeding prescription.
rules.specialist_database_rule: A specialist Safe to Feed classification does not by itself establish staple, unlimited, frequency, or percentage guidance.
rules.directness_rule: Evidence directness is categorical and must not be converted into an arbitrary numeric score.
rules.limitation_rule: Every public evidence record must state what the source does not support or what limits its application.

record_fields.plant_ids: master plant ids to which the record is relevant
record_fields.animal_taxon: animal taxon/population actually covered by the source; use not_applicable when the evidence is plant identity, plant chemistry, human nutrition, or other non-animal evidence with no applicable animal taxon
record_fields.applicability: exact_taxon | species | mediterranean_testudo | tortoise_general | herbivorous_reptile_general | composition_only
record_fields.plant_part_state: leaf/flower/whole aerial parts/etc plus fresh/dried state when known
record_fields.does_not_support: claims not established by the source
